notes.title: Release version is out!!!
notes.notes:
Astro Commandos, Assemble! Release version of the game is out so it's time to hit that nefarious Order of B.O.O.B right in the titty!

These things should be longer but that's pretty much all I have after five long years of development. Outside of the fact that, should this thing catch on, we have a huge plans for development so this finale is really only a start.

notes.title: Full Release is delayed by a week or two
notes.notes:
But don't feel too disappointed - 99% of the game is already in the early access so if you want to check out, there's not much reason to wait. 

The delay is more about trying to cram a bit more help/tutorial inside the game so people will have easier time to get in - our game is awesome but does need some time to learn all the ropes and we want to make this process go a bit smoother.

notes.title: Full Release in three weeks - on April 10th
notes.notes:
On the second week of April the game will finally exit the early access. What's to expect in the full version:

- Commando Squad Assembler: gives you a full control over your squad's initial setup and their equipment. And, should it feel too overwhelming, there's a "suggest a decent squad" button that'll provide 30 decent presets for each Assembly.

- Non-combat events will provide some challenging economical choices.

- Serious rebalance of combat, skills and abilities.

- UI enhancements for more comfortable play.

notes.notes: Fixed crashes on Ragepost! & Knightly Assault combo.

notes.title: Major Early Access Rework is Out
notes.notes:
We've promised to release a major update this month - well, we're doing it. 

TBH, after a year and a half of hard work, I'm a bit speechless. I'm not even sure how you make a changelog as the change is almost everything - the rough concept of the game is the same, but the entire point is that it is not one tenth as rough as it was. It's still a hardcore game for people who like tough battles - something like a crossbreed of Into the Breach and Darkest Dungeon, with a dash of Slay the Spire added. 

But whereas previously the major challenge lied in understanding what the hell is going on in the game, now we've added layers upon layers of useful interface so you can track all that stuff easily - state of the enemies, condition of your commandos, special attack properties, morale, accuracy, everything is visible right now. The interface can use some further polishing, but it's mostly minor things - all major stuff has been done.

The build is slightly rushed out - we've tried to release before all the sales hype begin, after all. But at least it doesn't crash & burn that often, so it should be mostly fine, I believe. I really want to believe that. Fight on, little build that could, fight on!

OK, now I hope you'll join the prestigious ranks of Astro Commandos and, with your glorious commando comrades, will do some Buttlerian Crusading all right.

notes.title: Major Update coming next month
notes.notes:
OK, so we've been silent about this project for almost 3 years now, but for a good reason - we've been busy as hell dialing it up to 11. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994227/6b55122c3c5c2f648ad3c3fe2e877cd94de4d38b.jpg[/img]

The changelog? Almost everything, really.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994227/39577bf51e623ee9d1ee449548e8a644507de366.jpg[/img]

New artstyle, animation (with glorious body physics), vastly improved accessibility, better attacks & equipment, better overall game flow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994227/fb89579f979a1f9a05f573032e5f2a47b4531360.jpg[/img]

More art, more jokes and whatnot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994227/3eb87c31f4c7b472f29acf30f20206bc493abdd9.jpg[/img]

TBH, it's almost like making a new game. Or maybe without the "almost" part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994227/79d0c37dc37f25a7f421d15a6b749f30004908b9.jpg[/img]

Anyhow, the new experience will easily rival Slay the Spire, Darkest Dungeon and Into the Breach - the game is somewhere in the middle of these three.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994227/f08484526eb99a82ee5d1e7dd8d624b2e65e066c.jpg[/img]

With hefty dose of match-3 being added - but it's not your grandmother's smartphone mellow match-3, it's stylish and tacticool match-3. If John Romero has introduced this kind of match-3 in his Daikatana (because, let's agree, that's exactly what that has been missing), we'd all become his you know what.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994227/6899df7c258b8ca32de33aa915184cbaaf1280ab.jpg[/img]

Overall, it's a game for people who like a body part that starts with "B" real big. I'm talking the Brain, obviously.

You can see it being played by me here, but keep in mind that it's a 2 month old and rather buggy build:
https://youtu.be/tCsspgs9AVs

We hoped to clean it up for the Steam's Autumn sale (which is why it's up there), but looks like it's more of a Winter Sale for us. Hope to see you there and have fun playing games in the meantime!
